title: 加州总检察长：Meta违法，为何仍要起诉？
speaker: Rob Bonta

segments.en: it's also an industry that brings a lot of money to the state of california whether it's alphabet whether it's metta platforms
segments.zh: 这也是一个为加州带来大量收入的行业，无论是Alphabet还是Meta平台

segments.en: you know it well they employ a lot they do a lot they probably pay a lot of taxes as well to your state
segments.zh: 他们雇佣很多人，做很多事，可能也缴纳很多税

segments.en: what is the balance it's always you know societal impact versus economic impacts how do you balance that how do you think about that and reconcile those two
segments.zh: 如何平衡社会影响和经济影响？您如何考虑并调和这两者？

segments.en: yeah it's pretty pretty straightforward and simple they have to follow the law period full stop
segments.zh: 这很简单直接，他们必须遵守法律，句号

segments.en: metta can be wildly successful and follow the law and i don't just suggest that i insist that they have to follow the law they cannot hurt our kids
segments.zh: Meta可以非常成功并遵守法律。我不只是建议，我坚持他们必须遵守法律，不能伤害我们的孩子

segments.en: and they have broken the law whether it be federal law and and taking advantage of the privacy of children under 13
segments.zh: 他们违反了法律，无论是联邦法律，还是利用13岁以下儿童的隐私

segments.en: or violating the false advertising law or the unfair competition law in our state by providing dangerous features
segments.zh: 或者违反虚假广告法、不正当竞争法，提供危险功能

segments.en: so we want businesses to found here in california to grow in california to create good jobs to contribute to us be in the fourth largest economy in the world
segments.zh: 我们希望企业在加州创立、成长，创造好工作，为世界第四大经济体做贡献

segments.en: and we want them to follow the law the law and we know that they they can and we know that they they well when we enforce and we insist that they must
segments.zh: 我们希望他们遵守法律，我们知道他们可以。当我们执法时，我们坚持他们必须

segments.en: so that the balance is you need to be a business that follows the law if metta has broken the law here so we're taking them to court
segments.zh: 所以平衡点在于，你必须成为守法的企业。如果Meta违法，我们就告上法庭

segments.en: if metta is big tobacco if metta is the sackler family as you've asserted attorney general do you want to put metta out of business
segments.zh: 如果Meta是“大烟草”，如果Meta是萨克勒家族，您是否想让Meta倒闭？

segments.en: i do not it's an analogy to the same conduct the same type of knowing conduct that harms the public doing it anyway doubling down on it and lying
segments.zh: 不。这是类比相同的行为，明知危害公众却照做，变本加厉并撒谎
